notes: burn.webp — не из модели: рваная обугленная кромка с тлеющим краем делается скриптом themes/the-hunger-games-catching-fire/burn.py (шум, порог, свечение), бесшовная по горизонтали. Тот же скрипт доводит flames.webp, sparks.webp, bolt.webp и mist.webp: убирает чёрный фон (яркость → прозрачность), а огонь и туман склеивает с зеркальной копией в бесшовную полосу — после перегенерации любого из них запустить его снова.

assets.name: flames
assets.prompt: A wide photograph of real fire against a pure black background, seen at eye level: a wild, uneven line of flames along the bottom edge — a few tall twisting tongues, several low ones, glowing embers and dark gaps between them, clearly irregular, not a neat row. Deep amber, dark orange and red, with bright yellow only in the hottest cores; thin wisps of dark smoke and a few drifting sparks above the flames. The upper 40 percent of the frame is pure black. Cinematic and moody, like a film still, high contrast. No objects, no ground, no logs, no text, no letters, no people.

assets.name: sparks
assets.prompt: Hundreds of tiny glowing embers and sparks floating in the air against a pure black background, scattered evenly across the whole frame from top to bottom with the same density everywhere, many different sizes, most of them small points, a few short motion-blurred streaks, warm orange and gold. Photorealistic, high contrast. No flames, no smoke, no objects, no text, no letters, no people.

assets.name: lace
assets.prompt: Macro photograph of ivory-white haute couture bridal fabric filling the whole frame edge to edge: layered organza ruffles and feather-like petals, rows of small pearls and fine silver thread embroidery, lit by a soft cold spotlight from above with gentle grey-blue shadows in the folds. Elegant, luxurious, calm. Wide composition, evenly detailed, no empty areas. No people, no hands, no mannequin, no text, no letters.

assets.name: feathers
assets.prompt: Macro photograph of overlapping black bird feathers filling the whole frame edge to edge, layered like the surface of a spread wing, with a deep blue and charcoal iridescent sheen; the tips of a few feathers glow with tiny orange embers as if freshly singed. Dark, dramatic, low-key lighting, very dark overall. Wide composition, evenly detailed. No bird head, no eyes, no people, no text, no letters.

assets.name: arena
assets.prompt: Cinematic matte painting at night, a wide high-angle view from above a tropical beach looking across a perfectly circular saltwater lagoon. In the center of the water sits a small rocky island with a large metallic horn-shaped structure on it, and twelve narrow straight rocky strips run from the island to the shore like the spokes of a wheel, dividing the water into equal wedges like a clock face. Around the lagoon lies a ring of pale sand and beyond it dense dark jungle. On the far shore, slightly right of center, one enormous ancient tree towers high above the jungle canopy against the sky. Heavy storm clouds overhead, cold moonlight breaking through and glinting on the water, a very faint hexagonal honeycomb shimmer high in the sky like an energy dome. Deep teal, indigo and violet palette, rich detail, dramatic and beautiful. The bottom corners are framed by dark foreground palm leaves. No lightning bolt, no people, no animals, no text, no letters.

assets.name: bolt
assets.prompt: A single huge branching lightning bolt striking straight down, photographed against a pure black background. The bright white-violet main channel runs from the top center of the frame to the bottom center, with many fine jagged side branches and a soft blue-violet glow around it. Photorealistic, high contrast. No clouds, no ground, no trees, no text, no letters.

assets.name: mist
assets.prompt: Thin wisps of low drifting fog photographed against a pure black background: soft pale horizontal streaks and curls of mist, uneven and airy, denser in the lower half and fading to nothing toward the top, the left and right edges look alike. Monochrome pale grey-white. No ground, no objects, no light source, no text, no letters.
